property_summary: For every admissible Collect call where the caller owns at least MinSum and the lock has expired, the caller's post-Collect balance is exactly their pre-Collect balance minus the attempted withdrawal amount, because the reference permits exact-balance withdrawals while the mutant rejects them due to the strict inequality acc.balance > _am.
change_summary: Change the Collect balance check from acc.balance >= _am to acc.balance > _am, preventing exact-balance withdrawals.
